description: ai81: exact bar-involution split of the net-route log R (sigma: s -> -s/(1+s)); tests the two-variable hypothesis log R = E(u~) + h*D(u~), u~ = q*u bar-even (h = q - 1/q companion bar-odd variable) by exact u-adic matching of the bar-even part and of (bar-odd)/h.

data.u_weight_finding: u o sigma = q^2 u exactly; bar-even variable is u~ = q*u
data.verdict: TWO-VARIABLE FORM HOLDS (to s^11, exact): log R = E(u~) + h*D(u~), with u~ = q*u the bar-even variable (u itself has bar-weight 2) and h = q - 1/q the companion bar-odd variable — the even channel IS a u-series after exact removal of the h-odd component; the honest bar-even ladder data are the e_k (E) with the d_k (D) as the odd-companion series. Scope (a): established to truncation order, on the net route.
data.scope: (a) — truncation order ORD, net route; no wiring
